about_the_game:
Delve into this dungeon crawler adventure that combines extraction and deck-building mechanics where every run will influence and change the outcome of any future runs!

The deeper you go, the bigger the loot, but you will need to manage your dwindling supplies and face stronger enemies. Just make sure you can get out alive!

And be careful as every dungeon tile can be rotated or pushed if you trigger specific traps or items.

Just make sure you have enough health and supplies to escape the dungeon!

If you die inside the dungeon, maybe other heroes will find your valuable loot, or if you carry certain artifacts, future explorers might find a surprise waiting for them...

And don't forget to Mind The Dragon as you try to escape the ever changing rotating dungeon tiles with plenty of loot and powerful artifacts to become a legend!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3gen or AMD Ryzen 4 gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Step into a deck-building adventure and venture into the depths of a legendary Dungeon. Steal treasures, gold and powerful artifacts! Just be careful with the monsters inside, rotating dungeons and the deeper you go the harder it is to escape! And don’t forget to... Mind the Dragon!
